claude-opus-5-5.title: 14th Transilvania Salsa Fest, 2026 Cluj-Napoca
claude-opus-5-5.description:
15 years later… and Dracula still dances. 🩸
Welcome back to the dark side of dance.
Welcome back to Transilvania Salsa Fest.
From 19–23 November 2026, the heart of Cluj-Napoca will beat once again in salsa, bachata & kizomba rhythms, while vampires, dancers and night creatures from all over the world gather under one roof for 5 unforgettable days.
🩸 4 nights of parties
🩸 1 Monday After Party – NEW
🩸 3 days of workshops
🩸 International artists & DJs
🩸 Social by day
🩸 Shows, energy, connection and bloody memories
📍 Grand Hotel Napoca – Cluj-Napoca, Romania
